findings.title: Clarify the scope of 吧’s modern Mandarin sound comparison
findings.details: The article’s 巴 bā / 吧 ba comparison is specifically for the sentence-final particle. The separate bar use is listed with Mandarin bā, and its English source pronunciation is not established. Current sound and learner-card wording does not make this distinction, leaving the sound comparison liable to be read as explaining the bar use.
findings.verification: Revise the Modern Mandarin sound explanation and corresponding learner presentation to identify 吧 ba as the particle reading and state that this comparison does not explain the bar use; retain the cited limitation that the bar borrowing’s source pronunciation is unresolved, then obtain fresh factual and readability reviews.

findings.title: Add present-day dictionary support to the bar sense
findings.details: The current 吧:bar sense and generated has_sense edge cite records that do not establish present-day Chinese usage. The supplied Ministry of Education dictionary evidence for 酒吧 and its English equivalent supports the current sense, but is absent from both citation lists.
findings.verification: Add X-052e4b77548f8a805191 to the current bar sense and generated has_sense edge, preserving the separate whole-character loan explanation, then obtain fresh factual and readability reviews.
